# Daytona runner-reaper — standalone version for existing installs. # # Reaps runner rows (and their sandbox rows) ONLY for nodes that no longer # exist, so the runner-manager's autoscaler can register a replacement. # # Why: when a sandbox node is recycled (AKS delete-machines, scale events, VM # faults) the runner row it backed goes unresponsive forever; the manager # counts it toward MIN_RUNNERS and never re-pushes credentials to the new # pod, so runners stay broken until someone intervenes.
